# Caligraphia — Product Roadmap

*A prioritized, opinionated plan. Synthesized from 7 research streams + codebase verification.*

---

## 1. The Big Picture — Three Strategic Bets

Caligraphia's problem is not the market — the market is actively trending toward it (Pinterest "handwritten letters" +45%, "snail mail gifts" +100%, a press-ready "anti-AI snail-mail revival" running in Dazed/AP/nss right now). The problem is **structural**: the entire app sits behind `<AuthGuard>` (`src/app/page.tsx` is `"use client"`, every route is gated, there is no `robots.ts`/`sitemap.ts`). A curious visitor, a Google crawler, and a Facebook share-bot all hit a wall and see *nothing*. Every growth lever is throttled to zero until that changes.

**Bet 1 — Open a "shop window," keep the house private.** Build one small, beautiful, server-rendered *public* surface (landing + curated gallery + opt-in shareable letters with OG cards). This single move unlocks SEO, social sharing, Product Hunt, a waitlist, and AdSense *eligibility* — all at once. The cozy private interior stays exactly as intimate as it is. This is the keystone; almost everything else depends on it.

**Bet 2 — Turn the artifact into the ad.** Handwriting, doodles, and the 3D photo-postcard flip are inherently screenshot- and video-bait. The hard 90% is already built (`/api/public/image/[id]`, gated on `isPubliclyVisible`, comment literally says "used by share cards / Open Graph"). Finish the front half — server-rendered permalink pages with `generateMetadata`, branded OG composites, native share buttons — so every link a member shares becomes a tiny piece of the product. This is the on-ethos growth engine; the owner has no ad budget, so *members sharing their own work* is the realistic flywheel.

**Bet 3 — Fix cold-start before chasing volume.** At ~6 users, dumping 200 strangers into an empty app makes them bounce. The fix is density + ritual: guarantee every new user a first pen-pal (a seeded handwritten welcome letter + write-back to their inviter), give a reason to return (a gentle daily prompt, a "letter waiting on your desk" state, an always-in-flight Postcrossing-style exchange), and reward inviting with the *existing* stamp currency. Monetization stays patronage/cosmetic — **not** AdSense (single-digit dollars/month at this scale, UGC policy risk, and it cheapens the calm brand the trend rewards).

> **The privacy rule that overrides everything below:** every public surface MUST funnel through `isPubliclyVisible` (in `src/lib/post-access.ts`) — **never** `canViewPost`, never the raw "public-to-members" set. Recipient-addressed letters, dead letters, private, scheduled, and needs-review posts can never leak via a card, crawler, gallery, or oEmbed. Going public is a *new, narrower, opt-in* tier, not a toggle on existing posts. And `ocrText`/`ocrHashtags` stay server-only forever (handwriting OCR can capture real names/addresses).

### DO NOT BUILD (strategic non-goals)
- **AdSense / EthicalAds / Carbon** now. No public inventory yet; ~$100–200/mo even at 20–40k pageviews; UGC = policy strikes (one bad doodle on an ad page); ~6 known viewers trips invalid-traffic detection; and ads contradict the calm brand. Revisit *only* if the public surface ever reaches real outside traffic — and then ads go **only** on editorial pages, never on user letters.
- **User-uploaded music files.** The one genuinely dangerous idea — inherits copyright liability with no fingerprinting infrastructure. Use streaming links (#22) or a curated catalog (#23) instead.
- **Meta / X auto-posting APIs.** Meta needs 4–8 wks app review + business verification per platform; X (as of Feb 2026) charges **$0.20 per post containing a URL** with no free tier. Native share intents (#4) do the same job for free.
- **Streaks, follower counts, emoji-reaction scoreboards, infinite scroll, pay-to-skip-the-queue.** The team already dropped the IG feed and scarce-stamp economy on purpose; re-adding gamification fights the owner's own decision.

## 3. Per-Theme Detail

### Growth (low/no-budget acquisition)
The realistic flywheel is **press-worthy concept → one discovery moment → word-of-mouth**, not ad spend — exactly how Slowly reached ~9M users with near-zero marketing. Target the *actual* demographic of the 2026 revival: **women, mid-20s–30s, reconnecting with creativity** — not generic "young people." Lead every message with **"written by a real human hand — no AI, no keyboards."**
- **Channels:** Reddit (`r/penpals` ~90k, `r/snailmail`, `r/fountainpens`, `r/calligraphy`, `r/bulletjournal`) — but only via *months of genuine build-in-public presence*; drop-and-run seeding permanently brands the app as spam. Pinterest (durable long-tail) + TikTok-first short video of ink flowing / postcards flipping (For-You distribution is follower-agnostic, share-driven).
- **Positioning play:** be the *soft landing* for a displaced niche (Letterboxd surged when IMDb killed its boards) — penpal-app users tired of ghosting/spam, snail-mailers who can't afford postage, people who want to *draw* not type.
- **Sequencing:** waitlist now → build to 300–500 warm signups → *then* a prepared Tue–Thu Product Hunt launch. A 6-user PH launch today would flop (40–60% of launch-day votes must come from a pre-warmed audience).

### Monetization / AdSense
Patronage and cosmetics beat ads on every axis for this app, and **Stripe is already fully wired** (`src/lib/payments.ts` `STAMP_PACKS`, checkout, webhook, even refunds). New offerings are mostly new SKUs on existing plumbing:
- **Supporter tier** (cosmetic only — extra stationery, supporter wax-seal/badge, larger photo limits). Never gameplay advantage; `ASSESSMENT.md` warns pay-to-skip "reads as desperate."
- **Custom stationery / collectible stamp designs** as one-off purchases (cosmetic — the one stamp use `VISION.md` preserves).
- **Print & mail for real** (later) — the one idea that *amplifies* the postal ethos; app already renders letters to images so it can POST to a mail API.
- **AdSense: explicitly shelved.** Structurally impossible today (no crawlable content, no privacy/terms/about), trivial money, real UGC + invalid-traffic ban risk.

### Community (genuine interaction, no ethos-breaking gamification)
The app is correspondence-first by its own decree — the public feed is "the lobby, not the building." Deepen correspondence and small-group ritual; don't add feed/discovery surface. Most primitives already exist (`Exchange`, `RoundRobin`, `GuestbookEntry`, `LetterRequest`, `Marginalia`, `Comment`); they're **under-activated**, not missing. North star = Slowly's anti-addiction mechanics (enforced delays, effort thresholds, **no streaks/likes/follower counts**) + Postcrossing's reciprocity (you receive *because* you sent).
- **Return rituals (the missing "why come back"):** gentle daily prompt, "on your desk" waiting state, always-in-flight exchange. Maven proved deep content *alone* doesn't drive return — you need a ritual, just not notification-bait.
- **Curation > algorithms:** a single `featuredAt` flag → "Letter of the Week," hand-picked from `/admin`. Zero ranking, doubles as front-page + Instagram content.
- **Reactions stay effortful & in-medium:** wax seal, tiny hand-drawn star/heart — never emoji bars or counts.
- **Welcome ritual:** route new arrivals to a small pool of greeters so their first inbox letter is from a *real human*, instantly creating the core 1:1 unit.

### Authentic features — music / audio / storytelling
Storage + private media-proxy already exist (`src/lib/storage.ts` MinIO; the `/api/media/comments/[id]` pattern: authed GET → access check → stream bytes) and are format-agnostic. **Self-recorded voice is the safest, most on-ethos new format** — it's the audio equivalent of handwriting and carries near-zero copyright risk.
- **Ship order:** voice postscript → moderation in the *same* change (reportable target, length caps, admin playback) → "letter + a song" via *link* → curated soundtrack shelf → audio round-robin.
- **iOS Safari trap to design around:** the mic locks to the first `getUserMedia` caller — tap the waveform `AnalyserNode` off the *same* stream feeding `MediaRecorder`; feature-detect format with `MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported()`. This is the #1 reason web recorders "work on desktop, fail on iPhone."
- **Hard rule:** every audio/link field must be whitelisted in `no-text-input.ts` and (for links) validated against a music-domain allowlist so it can't smuggle typed text.

### Social spread — the OG-card strategy
The back 90% is built and gated correctly; the gap is the **front** half (no logged-out permalink *page*, no `generateMetadata`, no `robots`/`sitemap`, zero share buttons). Crawlers (`facebookexternalhit`, `Twitterbot`, `Discordbot`) make **one non-JS request** and read only first-byte HTML — so the existing `"use client"` `/post/[id]` page is invisible to them and a 401 for bots. The permalink **must** be a new Server Component using `generateMetadata`. Then: branded OG composite (use `@napi-rs/canvas`+`sharp`, *not* `@vercel/og` — self-hosted via Cloudflare tunnel, not edge), `navigator.share()` + intent fallbacks, oEmbed as phase 2. This turns every member into a recruiter.

### Onboarding / ergonomics
The app has **zero first-run state** (no `localStorage` anywhere) — every onboarding idea is greenfield and a single `caligraphia_seen_*` key unlocks most. Signup dumps new users onto a feed of strangers with two empty personalized surfaces. Fixes, all front-end:
- Seeded welcome letter (fills inbox, models a finished letter, teaches stamp + reply gestures).
- One-time gesture coach overlay (surface palm rejection / two-finger zoom / eraser that `CanvasDraw` already supports but never reveals).
- Explain the **8-second wet-ink gate** inline ("the ink is still wet — keep writing") — currently looks like a broken send button.
- Promote the daily prompt to the new-user hero; sequence **doodle-first → letter** (lower stakes warms the hand).
- Add a visible **undo** affordance + audit toolbar targets to 44px (WCAG 2.2 min 24px; VoiceOver reserves swipe/double-tap, so gesture-only actions need button equivalents).

### Public front page — privacy rules that MUST hold
- Render on the **server** (`generateMetadata`); a privacy-flag toggle alone leaves crawlers an empty shell.
- Going public is a **new opt-in `isShowcased` tier** + one-time account consent — never silently exposing the existing "public-to-members" set (those ~6-trusted-eyes letters would become Google-indexed forever).
- Every public surface gates on `isPubliclyVisible`, never `canViewPost`. Recipient-addressed letters are `isPrivate=true` by construction (`posts/route.ts`: `isPrivate = flag || !!recipientId || isDeadLetter`) and can never leak.
- **Never render `ocrText`/`ocrHashtags`** in public HTML or meta tags — moderation-only.
- OG image route already short-caches (`max-age=300`) so un-publishing propagates fast — mirror that on the page.
- Lead with **feeling + one human story** (Slowly's "Across 3,700 miles and 3 years…"), invitational copy ("Step inside," "Join us"), honest small-numbers framing ("a quiet handful of letter-writers" — smallness is the feature), authentic momentum not fake countdowns.

## 4. The First Sprint — 8 Features, In Order

Build the public keystone and close the cold-start holes. Every item below is buildable now with no external account.

1. **Public landing page** *(M)* — a server-rendered route outside `AuthGuard`: ethos + real handwriting samples + "no keyboards, no AI, written by a real human hand" hook + waitlist email capture. The foundation every other channel depends on.
2. **Public letter permalink `/letter/[id]`** *(M)* — new Server Component (not the client `/post/[id]`); fetch server-side, run `isPubliclyVisible`, emit OG + Twitter card tags; `notFound()` on fail. Crawlers see real HTML on first byte.
3. **`isShowcased` opt-in + consent** *(M)* — per-letter "Show on the public gallery" flag (default false) + one-time plain-language account consent; gate every public surface on this *in addition to* `isPubliclyVisible`.
4. **Share buttons** *(S)* — `navigator.share()` from a click handler with anchor-intent fallback (X/FB/Pinterest/mailto/copy-link). No keys, no review, works on the existing HTTPS tunnel.
5. **`robots.ts` + `sitemap.ts`** *(S)* — enumerate only showcased permalinks + landing/about; disallow `/inbox`, `/admin`, `/api`, `/post/new`. Cheap compounding SEO for a trending niche.
6. **Seeded handwritten welcome letter** *(S)* — pre-rendered founder/house letter dropped into every new inbox via the existing seed plumbing; replaces the bare "Your postbox is empty" state and invites the first stamp + reply.
7. **First-run canvas gesture coach** *(S)* — translucent one-time overlay ("two fingers to zoom," "rest your palm — only the pen draws," "tap the eraser to lift ink"), dismissed by tap, remembered via one `localStorage` key.
8. **Explain the 8s wet-ink gate** *(S)* — replace the vague ambient hint with explicit microcopy + subtle progress fill on the disabled seal button ("the ink is still wet — keep writing to seal"), at least on the first letter. Pure `CanvasDraw.tsx` change.

**Why this order:** 1–5 stand up the shop window and the share loop (Bets 1 + 2) — the structural unlock that ungates SEO, social previews, the waitlist, and eventually AdSense eligibility, all while keeping the private house untouched. 6–8 plug the most acute cold-start and first-run leaks (Bet 3) so the visitors those shares bring don't bounce off an empty inbox or a button that looks broken. Once this sprint lands, the **invite→stamp referral loop (#11)** and **voice postscript (#14)** are the natural next builds.

*Note: the draw-time gate is `minDrawTimeMs={8000}` (8s, set in `src/app/post/new/page.tsx` and `src/app/robins/page.tsx`) — not 4s as one research note assumed.*
